notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W7-13-Q01_7 railway level crossing warning sign (2022, page 7 of 7): T-junction with an oblique railway crossing. Size A 600 (B 750, C 900 also tabled): side 600 drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, yellow edge 8 + black border 16. The sheet's vectors are to scale; table A: d 250, e 150, f 90. Symbol: the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-13-q01-7_legend.svg, items 101-103), placed as the sheet draws it: 397.0 x 495.3 with its box 247.9 left / 149.1 right of the vertical centreline and 247.5 above / 247.8 below the horizontal centreline. Black on retroreflective yellow.
